name: Gaston Delacroix
source:
Joseph's right-hand man.
He is a very large man, and his weapon is a huge custom-made mall that ordinary people cannot handle.

He is aware that he is not very smart, and since Joseph saved him with his quick thinking a long time ago, he has respected him as a "smart older brother" and has been by his side ever since.

He also has a penis so large that Joseph calls it "monster-sized."
